top.titulo: OPEC+ Faces Growing Pressure As Iraq Pushes for Higher Quota
top.resumen_es: Iraq is negotiating with OPEC for permission to produce more oil, Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair said Friday, arguing that the country needs a higher production ceiling to develop its energy infrastructure. The request comes ahead of Sunday's OPEC+ meetings on production policy for 2027. For now, Iraq isn't likely to get what it wants.
